threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a ‘bottle shop’ just sells bottles and not craft beers. And you ask for a flat white like you're in a tourist café.
Last night on the 333, a bloke serenaded us with a 20-minute rendition of 'Wonderwall' while the driver looked on, mildly amused.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I passed a street musician playing an accordion while a couple danced next to a food truck selling the best döner. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find a late-night kebab stand that doubles as an art gallery, complete with local artists' work on the walls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: If you know to avoid the BART platform at Civic Center during rush hour, you’re probably from here. Tourists seem shocked every time it shuts down.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy singing opera on the 31 Balboa this morning. Whole bus went quiet, then joined in on the chorus. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think tapas means sharing small plates, but locals often enjoy their own, a quiet moment with a few olives and a vermut amid the buzz.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still look puzzled when the clock strikes 11 and the bars start to fill up. A true local knows it's just the pre-party warm-up.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check the Tube app for delays like it's gospel, while the rest of us just ignore it and cycle past. Welcome to Hackney!
Caught the N35 last night; the driver stopped for a group of pigeons crossing the road. Never seen that before on a night bus!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy in socks and sandals arguing with a pigeon over a leftover kebab on Sonnenallee.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a park where locals set up mini outdoor cinemas, complete with blankets and popcorn, right under the stars.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by the way they navigate around the BART delays without missing a beat—while newcomers stand around baffled at the schedule.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy juggling on the bus while debating the best burrito in the Mission—definitely a classic San Francisco moment. It’s these oddities that keep us sane!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar has free tapas, but most locals just sip their vermut without a plate in sight. It's all about the company.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them easily: just look for the ones staring at the metro map like it's a treasure map, utterly confused by the L1 and L3 lines.
